sources.name: Costco Australia
sources.title: Warehouse savings
sources.description: Bulk groceries, household essentials and rotating warehouse offers. Membership required. Warehouse prices may differ from online prices.
sources.note: Shop in warehouse; this is not a click-and-collect offer.

sources.name: Woolworths
sources.title: Half-price specials
sources.description: Browse the official half-price range and weekly specials. Select your store or delivery address to see local prices and availability.
sources.note: Pickup / Direct to boot availability and fees depend on the store and order.

sources.name: Coles
sources.title: Weekly specials & catalogue
sources.description: Compare supermarket specials and browse this week's catalogue. Set your local store before checking prices.
sources.note: Check Click & Collect slots, minimum spend and delivery fees with Coles.

sources.name: ALDI
sources.title: Super Savers
sources.description: Grocery savings on everyday essentials. Offers and stock vary by store.
sources.note: Check your local store's catalogue before travelling.

sources.name: ALDI Special Buys
sources.title: Wednesday & Saturday Special Buys
sources.description: Rotating home, garden, clothing and technology ranges. Limited stock; new ranges arrive twice a week.
sources.note: Special Buys are not necessarily discounted from a previous price.

sources.name: IGA
sources.title: Local supermarket specials
sources.description: Choose your local IGA to view its catalogue. Participating stores, ranges and prices differ.
sources.note: Confirm any online ordering or collection options with your chosen store.
